deviations: D1 (Temp password charset): 16-char password using unambiguous charset ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789 (strips 0/O/1/I/l). Uses RandomNumberGenerator.GetString (.NET 8+). Work factor 11 explicitly to match StaffLoginEndpoint.

D2 (Email immutability): Email and Role are immutable in v1. UpdateStaff only accepts displayName, phone, isActive. Reason: changing role would require creating or deleting the Driver row, and changing email would break existing auth flows. Documented in endpoint Summary.

D3 (Phone nullability): User.Phone is required (non-null). CreateStaff and UpdateStaff store req.Phone ?? string.Empty when phone is not supplied. UserConfiguration declares Phone as IsRequired().HasMaxLength(20). An empty string is stored — consistent with staff members who have no phone number on record.
D4 (Role allowlist as HashSet): Validator uses a HashSet<string> with Driver/Dispatcher/FleetAdmin membership check, rather than NotEqual(Customer). This correctly blocks SuperAdmin and System too.

D5 (User is NOT ITenantEntity): CreateStaff explicitly sets user.FleetId = currentTenant.FleetId!.Value because User does not implement ITenantEntity (nullable FleetId for Customer/SuperAdmin). Without explicit assignment the user would have null FleetId and be invisible to ListStaff and unable to log in.

D6 (ListStaff explicit role filter): ListStaff uses a role predicate (Driver/Dispatcher/FleetAdmin) in addition to the ambient tenant query filter. The User query filter is not ITenantEntity-based for User (soft filter on non-null FleetId rows), so without the role predicate Customer users in the same fleet could appear.

D7 (Deactivation guards on both PUT and DELETE): Originally (D7 in round 1) guards applied only to DELETE. Round-2 fix (F3) applies the same self-deactivation and online-driver guards to PUT when isActive transitions true→false. Guards are implemented as two private methods on UpdateStaffEndpoint. DeactivateStaffEndpoint Summary updated to remove the now-incorrect note about PUT bypassing guards.
D8 (Deactivation is soft delete): DELETE sets IsActive=false, never hard-deletes. Preserves referential integrity with historical data.
D9 (GetStaff includes explicit role filter): GetStaff uses explicit role predicate to prevent returning Customer or SuperAdmin rows even if they somehow match the tenant query filter.

D10 (TDD deviation): RED observed for the pinned happy path test (CreateStaff_FleetAdmin_ReturnsTempPasswordOnce — 404 before endpoints existed). Remaining 11 integration tests were authored pre-implementation and first executed green against the finished implementation. Validator unit tests were also written after the validator existed. One-RED evidence cycle for the pinned test; others pre-authored per WI instructions.

D11 (Phone not E.164-normalized on create/update): Phone is stored as-supplied without E.164 normalization via PhoneNormalizer. Staff phone is informational, not used for auth (SMS OTP is customer-only). Acknowledged as a v1 limitation.

D12 (AddError argument order fixed — round 2): Five inverted AddError(code, message) calls in WI-09/WI-11 code were corrected to AddError(message, code) at: CreateVehicleEndpoint.cs:50, UpdateVehicleEndpoint.cs:56, GoOnlineEndpoint.cs:63, GoOfflineEndpoint.cs:63 and :71. Canonical order confirmed from DeactivateStaffEndpoint (AddError(message, code)). GoOnline_AlreadyOnline_Returns409 extended to assert both errors[0].reason == human-readable message AND errors[0].code == ErrorCodes.Driver.AlreadyOnline. To expose the code field in ProblemDetails responses, Program.cs was updated: c.Errors.UseProblemDetails(x => x.IndicateErrorCode = true). FE 8.3 ProblemDetails errors array shape with IndicateErrorCode: {name, reason, code, severity}.

D13 (F2 — test name mapping): Pinned WI-12 test names as delivered: DeleteStaff→DeactivateStaff_SetsInactive (functional coverage identical, name reflects that DELETE is a soft-deactivation, not a hard delete), UpdateStaff_FleetAdmin_Returns200→UpdateStaff_FleetAdmin_UpdatesFields (name was clarified to reflect what is asserted). Validator test CreateStaffValidator_InvalidEmail_FailsWithEmailInvalidCode tests the EmailInvalid error code.
